item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 2022-06-21
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (291 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 怠惰的怪獸公主不想工作
  • 英語名: Namake Kaijuu Hime wa Hatarakitakunai

别名

  • Namake Kaijuu Hime wa Hatarakitakunai

あらすじ

Living with a mysterious invader from outer space… who controls horrifying kaijus! (but she’s pretty lazy)

The player plays a general office worker, life is nothing new and exciting.

One day, the man left a message on the homestay website. This website is specially designed for homeless women.
